text: The Weyl vector $\rho = \frac{1}{2}\sum_{\alpha \in \Phi^+}\alpha$ is one half the sum of all ___ roots, and equivalently equals the sum of the fundamental weights.
explanation: $\rho$ is the half-sum of the positive roots (equivalently $\sum_i \omega_i$). It is not the half-sum of the simple roots, nor of all roots — summing every root gives $0$ because roots come in $\pm$ pairs.
